C362338 -- IF you ever fit the crystal instead of the TCXO: TXM25M0004322DBCDO00T, 25 MHz, SMD3225-4P, 10 pF load, +/-10 ppm tolerance, +/-20 ppm over -40..+85 C, 30 ohm ESR.
Round 24 surveyed 100 distinct 25 MHz 3225 crystals against Si5351 Table 8 (CL 6-12 pF, ESR <= 150 ohm, drive >= 100 uW) and note 1 (only 6, 8 or 10 pF can use the internal load capacitance, register 183 bits 7:6).  Results: 6 pF parts all exist but every one is at 52 pieces or fewer, so 8 and 10 pF are the real choices; +/-10 ppm is the tightest tolerance made in this package, so nothing better is available.  With ESR the only remaining discriminator and a 150 ohm limit, this part's 30 ohm is the lowest of any fully specified candidate.
Alternates: C70582 (YXC X322525MMB4SI, identical but 50 ohm ESR, 58k in stock -- take it if availability matters more) and C448646 (NDK NX3225SA, a better maker, but LCSC publishes neither an ESR nor a stability figure for it).
Do NOT take the top search hit ABM8W-25.0000MHZ-4-D1X-T3: it is a 4 pF part, below the Si5351's 6 pF minimum, and no register setting can correct it
